Historical description:

Standalone record of the Viridis Canon — a direct extension of the core Intelligence Bound (the two-body generalization). The core IB canon spine is unchanged (frozen at v9, record 20724138); this record links to the spine via isDerivedFrom the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19317982.

The Intelligence Bound dI/dt ≤ P·D/(k_B T ln 2) has, in each of its thirteen prior self-applications, constrained a single intelligence (this is the fourteenth). The central thesis of conservation technology is that artificial intelligence and the living biosphere are not master and resource but partners. This paper supplies the rate law for that partnership. Fusing bipartite information thermodynamics (Horowitz–Esposito, with the 2024 information-arbitrage refinement), the thermodynamics of prediction (Still–Sivak–Bell–Crooks), and the Good Regulator Theorem (Conant–Ashby), it proves the Symbiotic Intelligence Bound (SIB): two coupled dissipative learners can each raise the rate at which they accumulate permanence-intelligence above their standalone ceiling by harvesting the predictive information the partner carries about the shared world, dI_A/dt ≤ P_A D_A/ε_L + Φ_(E→A).

Three laws govern the subsidy: (i) No free lunch — at the coupled fixed point the information one partner consumes is, bit for bit, what the other regenerates (İ^A = −İ^E), paid in dissipation; (ii) Complementarity — the rate subsidy vanishes at equilibrium and is nonzero only across distinct fluctuation sources, a thermodynamic derivation of ecological niche differentiation (cooperation requires complementarity, not similarity); (iii) Threshold — a sharp Symbiotic Transition partitions couplings into mutualistic (super-additive learning) and parasitic. The extraction efficiency is the universal cos²Θ Fisher–Rao alignment factor. The paper gives the Good Regulator Theorem its first thermodynamic, bidirectional form — each partner is the other's good regulator, capped by the Intelligence Bound — naming the biosphere-as-Regulator the 14th Intelligence-Bound self-application.

Scope. Lean 4 (Aristotle-verified, zero sorry, axioms ⊆ {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}) certifies the structural results — the joint-bound recovery, NESS reciprocity, no-perpetual-learning dissipation positivity, the mutualism/parasitism threshold, and the bounded cos²Θ extraction efficiency — not empirical magnitudes. 18/18 numeric checks pass. Working paper; not peer-reviewed.

after_expected_public: Viridis Canon, standalone record (Intelligence-Bound CORE EXTENSION / two-body generalization; 14th IB self-application, 'the Regulator'). Rate/flow twin of the Symbiotic Valuation Theorem (SVT). Lean 4 proofs (Aristotle project a0660ac8-5fef-4e22-b779-254fe09ca47e, run 09f7fe35, zero sorry, axioms within {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound} on all 5 named theorems, toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.28.0, Mathlib pin 8f9d9cff) certify: (1) joint_bound_from_partners -- each partner's learning rate obeys its solo IB ceiling plus the partner's predictive subsidy, and the directed subsidies cancel at the coupled fixed point to recover the joint Intelligence Bound; (2) ness_reciprocity -- at a nonequilibrium steady state the directed information flows are exactly equal and opposite (bit-for-bit regeneration); (3) no_perpetual_learning -- a strictly positive net subsidy bounded by total entropy production forces strictly positive dissipation; (4) symbiotic_surplus_threshold -- a sharp mutualism-vs-parasitism sign change in the net symbiotic surplus; (5) cos_sq_extraction_bounded -- the universal cos^2(Theta) Fisher-Rao extraction-efficiency bound in [0,1] (7th canon appearance). The Lean proofs certify the validity of the reasoning, not empirical magnitudes; the paper develops a richer model than the verified abstraction. Working paper; not peer-reviewed. Does NOT modify the core canon spine (frozen at v9, record 20724138); flagged as the lead candidate for a future curated spine v10 wave (Justin's per-instance OK required).
